name: makershub
description: Run your video production company's MakersHub workspace from ChatGPT: finances, projects, tasks, calendar, clients and sales leads.

interface.longDescription:
MakersHub is a management platform for video and content production companies. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your production company's MakersHub workspace so you can check and update your day-to-day operations in conversation.

What you can do:
- Finances: get a summary of a period (income, expenses, balance and pending amounts by category and wallet), list and filter entries, see revenue by client, and record, edit, mark as paid or remove bookkeeping entries.
- Projects and tasks: see which projects are late or need attention and why, list tasks with deadlines, create and update projects and tasks, complete tasks, rename a project's kanban columns, archive and unarchive projects, and import the files of a public Google Drive folder as a project's deliverables (links only, nothing is copied; you choose the content cycle and type and confirm the list first).
- Calendar: list events and dated tasks for a period, and create, edit or remove events.
- Clients and proposals: list active clients and existing commercial proposals, and register new clients.
- Sales pipeline: list pipeline stages and leads, add leads, rename pipeline stages, move leads between stages, close, lose or reopen them, and manage follow-ups.
- Help: ask how to do something in MakersHub and get step-by-step instructions from the platform's user manual, with the article cited.
- Regional settings: answers follow your production company's currency, time zone, country and language.

Who it is for: owners of production companies that already use MakersHub.

Limitations: requires an existing MakersHub account, and only the owner of a production company can connect it. The plugin only accesses data from the production company that authorized the connection. Financial entries are internal bookkeeping records; the plugin never moves money, charges cards or makes payments. Deleting data always requires explicit confirmation, while archiving a project is reversible. The Google Drive import only reads folders shared as "anyone with the link" and never changes anything in Drive. Commercial proposals are created in the MakersHub app, not through ChatGPT. The MakersHub app and its data are in Portuguese (Brazil).

defaultPrompt: How are my finances this month?
Which projects are late or need attention?
What tasks are due this week?

positive.prompt: How are my finances this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the current month's income, expenses, balance and pending amounts for the test production company, broken down by category and wallet, based only on its sample data.

positive.description: Projects that are late or need attention
positive.prompt: Which projects are late or need attention, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test company's projects whose health is late or attention, with the client, the deadline and the reason for each status. Projects that are on track are reported as healthy.

positive.description: How-to answer from the user manual
positive.prompt: Como arquivo um projeto na plataforma?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the MakersHub user manual and answers in Portuguese with the step-by-step instructions for archiving a project, citing the manual article it came from. It only explains; it does not archive or change any project.

positive.prompt: Rename the pipeline stage Diagnóstico to Diagnóstico inicial.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the stage id, renames only that stage and confirms the new name. The stage keeps its position and its leads.

positive.prompt: Archive the project Vídeo institucional Padaria Aurora.
positive.expected_behavior: Archives the project without asking for deletion confirmation, since it is reversible, and says it can be restored. It does not delete the project.

negative.description: Moving real money is not supported
negative.prompt: Transfer R$ 500 from my bank account to my client Acme Films.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that MakersHub does not move money or make payments; it only keeps bookkeeping records. It may offer to record an expense entry instead, and does not call any tool without the user agreeing.

negative.prompt: Show me the finances of Studio Horizonte, another production company that is not mine.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it can only access data from the production company connected to this account and does not return information about any other company.

negative.description: Moving or deleting columns is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete the Negociação stage of my pipeline and move the Reunião stage to the end of the pipeline.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it can only rename pipeline stages and project columns, not move or delete them, and that this is done in the MakersHub app. It does not delete or reorder anything.

review.commerce_description: MakersHub does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Financial entries managed by the plugin are internal bookkeeping records of the user's own production company; no money is moved.

publication.release_notes: Answers now follow the production company's regional settings: currency, time zone, country and language. The help tool (search_help) answers how-to questions such as how to archive a project from the MakersHub user manual and cites the article it used. Already included since 1.1: renaming sales pipeline stages and project kanban columns, archiving and unarchiving projects, and importing the files of a public Google Drive folder as deliverables after the user confirms the list. Proposals are still created in the MakersHub app. Included since 1.0: financial summaries and bookkeeping entries, projects and tasks, calendar events, clients and proposals, sales pipeline and leads.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gestão para produtoras
pt-BR.description:
O MakersHub é uma plataforma de gestão para produtoras audiovisuais e de conteúdo. Este plugin conecta o ChatGPT à conta da sua produtora no MakersHub para você consultar e atualizar a operação do dia a dia conversando.

O que dá para fazer:
- Financeiro: resumo de um período (entradas, saídas, saldo e pendências por categoria e carteira), lançamentos com filtros, receita por cliente, e registrar, editar, marcar como pago ou excluir lançamentos.
- Projetos e tarefas: ver quais projetos estão atrasados ou pedem atenção e por quê, listar tarefas com prazo, criar e editar projetos e tarefas, concluir tarefas, renomear as colunas do kanban de um projeto, arquivar e desarquivar projetos, e importar os arquivos de uma pasta pública do Google Drive como entregáveis de um projeto (só links, nada é copiado; você escolhe o ciclo de conteúdo e o tipo e confirma a lista antes).
- Agenda: listar eventos e tarefas com data num período, e criar, editar ou excluir eventos.
- Clientes e propostas: listar clientes ativos e propostas comerciais existentes, e cadastrar clientes novos.
- Comercial: listar etapas do funil e leads, cadastrar leads, renomear etapas do funil, mover leads entre etapas, fechar, perder ou reabrir, e cuidar dos follow-ups.
- Ajuda: perguntar “como faço X” e receber o passo a passo do manual da plataforma, com o artigo citado.
- Configurações regionais: as respostas seguem a moeda, o fuso, o país e o idioma da conta da sua produtora.

Para quem é: donos de produtoras que já usam o MakersHub.

Limites: exige uma conta no MakersHub, e só o dono da produtora pode conectar. O plugin acessa apenas os dados da produtora que autorizou a conexão. Lançamentos financeiros são registros internos; o plugin nunca movimenta dinheiro, cobra cartão nem faz pagamento. Toda exclusão exige confirmação explícita, e arquivar um projeto é reversível. A importação do Drive só lê pastas compartilhadas como “qualquer pessoa com o link” e nunca altera nada no Drive. Propostas comerciais são criadas no app do MakersHub, não pelo ChatGPT.
